reviews.text: Took my golden retriever here on a Sunday — staff brought a water bowl without us even asking. Outdoor seating only for pets but plenty of shade.
Great cold brew. Saw a couple of dogs at the patio tables, seems like a regular thing here.
Lovely courtyard, very pet friendly. My beagle and indie both welcomed. They have a small menu for dogs too!
Calm place to work from. Lots of pets around on weekends which I loved.

name: The Hole in the Wall Cafe

reviews.text: We were turned away because we had our small pomeranian with us. Disappointing, the listing online said pet friendly.
Best english breakfast in town. Long wait on weekends.
One of the few resorts that genuinely welcomes large dogs. Our labrador had the time of his life. Pet fee of Rs 1000 per night, fenced lawn.
Pet friendly stay, they allowed our two cats in the cottage. Carrier required in common areas.
Rooftop view is great, food average.
Stayed with our indie dog — no extra charge, but pets not allowed in the restaurant area. Rooms open onto the lawn which is perfect.
